assertions: Cross-tenant run status and cancellation requests returned opaque 404 responses and did not change the authorized tenant's accepted work.
ETLantic durably recorded cancel_requested before the adapter contacted Prefect.
A simulated lost Prefect cancellation response left the canonical request intact; retry requested cancellation again without changing canonical state.
A later Prefect Completed observation was projected as reconciliation-required while canonical ETL status remained cancel_requested.
limitations: This is an in-memory contract test with a controlled Prefect client; live cancellation during staging, commit, publication, and terminal races remains open.
